instruction: Catch the QR code payment sign from the table and rotate it

source.instruction: Catch the QR code payment sign from the table and rotate it

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the qrcode, which was at x = +24 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right arm closer to the sign at x=24.5 cm and roll -90 degrees to orient fingers horizontally for grasping.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-6, -1, -0) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the qrcode

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (24, -20, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Pitch and yaw right gripper by 90 degrees to align with sign's top edge.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the qrcode

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (24, -20, 94) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm to z=89 cm, adjust y slightly forward, and grasp the sign firmly.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +1, -4) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the qrcode; closed the gripper (opening 0.12: holding the qrcode)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (24, -18, 89) opening 0.12; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift the sign up to z=96 cm clear of the table.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +7) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the qrcode

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (24, -18, 96) opening 0.13; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate sign 90 degrees yaw and shift position slightly to reorient it.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-4, +5, -0) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the qrcode

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -13, 96) opening 0.13; table z = 74
frames.plan: Fine tune x position slightly before placing back down.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the qrcode

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -13, 96) opening 0.14; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm by 5.5 cm to table level and release gripper to place the sign.
